Step 1: 1012 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century year not divisible by 400).  
Step 2: Aug 30, 1012 + 218 days.  
From Aug 30 to Dec 31:  
Aug: 1 day left (31-30) → Sep (30) + Oct (31) + Nov (30) + Dec (31) = 1+30+31+30+31 = 123 days.  
Remaining days: 218 - 123 = 95 days into 1013.  
Step 3: 1013 is not leap (not divisible by 4). Jan 31 + Feb 28 = 59 days, leaving 95 - 59 = 36 days into March.  
March 31 days → April 5th (since 36 - 31 = 5).  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1013-04-05
